facts.heading: Flashback about fire event

facts.evidence: It started two years ago, when it was burning next door and we had to evacuate. The alarm rang. There was smoke on the hallway and it was screaming.

facts.heading: Feeling after fire event

facts.evidence: It was like the end. Nobody was hurt, but the neighbor was burning whole.

facts.evidence: Since then I feel like I can manage it. That if something doesn't work out, it will happen and I will be in trouble.

facts.heading: Inability to turn off control
